name: IllegalStateSpec
source_title: Requested canonical CrySL source, IllegalState.crysl — fetch returned HTTP 404; no rule text was available to consult.
important_note: No primary IllegalState.crysl rule was found. "unresolved.IllegalState" is an explicit placeholder used to preserve the requested CrySL XSpec naming shape; it is not a verified Java/Kotlin API type and must not be replaced with an unrelated namesake API. events.name: terminal_session_initialize_observation
api_patterns: "Cannot start terminal session before engine is ready."
events.condition: Observing a call textually matching .initialize( on a TerminalSession-like receiver, or observing construction or throwing of the quoted exception message, is only a candidate event. It does not establish that the EngineReady predicate holds.

events.name: desktop_layout_restore_state_observation
api_patterns: "Workspace state cannot be restored before layout passes."
events.condition: Observing a call textually matching .restoreState( on a DesktopLayout-like receiver, or observing construction or throwing of the quoted exception message, is only a candidate event. It does not establish that the LayoutPassesComplete predicate holds.

forbidden_inferences_without_evidence: That com.termux.terminal.TerminalSession has a method named initialize in the analyzed revision.
That ch.deletescape.lawnchair.workspace.DesktopLayout and its restoreState method belong to the CrySL corpus.
That either reported exception message is present verbatim in upstream source rather than being generated, normalized, transformed, or supplied by a project-local wrapper.
That EngineReady or LayoutPassesComplete is represented by any particular field, callback, lifecycle state, thread, or happens-before relation.
That IllegalStateSpec describes java.lang.IllegalStateException, any type ending in Exception, or an unrelated namesake such as a nested IllegalState type from another framework.
That a reported IllegalStateException is a security vulnerability or that avoiding the exception proves correct runtime behavior.
semantic_scope: At most, this detector label can describe potential violations of the two reported readiness-before-operation predicates at the indicated call sites. It does not establish a CrySL rule, a common governed API class, an implementation-level state machine, or a security property.

detector_semantics.claim: A finding would indicate that a reported operation may be reached without evidence for the readiness condition stated by that operation's reported IllegalStateException message.
predicates: For TerminalSession.initialize, observing a matching call or matching exception-message site is distinct from proving EngineReady before the operation.
For DesktopLayout.restoreState, observing a matching call or matching exception-message site is distinct from proving LayoutPassesComplete before the operation.
limitations: The requested canonical CrySL source was missing at the supplied URL.
No primary Lawnchair source for the reported DesktopLayout type, method, and message was located during the source-discovery pass.

The current upstream Termux TerminalSession source declares initializeEmulator(...) and invokes it from updateSize(...); this does not verify the reported initialize method or its reported exception message.
Static local substring matching cannot prove object identity, dynamic-dispatch target, predicate truth, exception reachability, thread ordering, or runtime configuration.

documented_behavior: The supplied findings state two proposed preconditions: terminal-session start requires a ready engine, and workspace restoration requires layout passes. These are unverified claims from the findings, not documented semantics recovered from an IllegalState.crysl source.

The current primary Termux source documents that terminal emulation begins after updateSize(...) makes size known, and implements initialization through initializeEmulator(...). This does not verify the reported initialize method or quoted message.
preconditions: Unverified finding-derived precondition: EngineReady before TerminalSession.initialize.
Unverified finding-derived precondition: LayoutPassesComplete before DesktopLayout.restoreState.
